title: The Empire, Long Divided, Must Unite: Architectural Convergence in Three LLM Agent Harnesses
abstract: arXiv:2608.23953v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: An agent harness is what turns a language model into an autonomous agent: the surrounding code that builds the model's context, mediates its tools, runs the loop, and persists state across a long-horizon run. This layer, not the model it wraps, is increasingly the binding constraint on agent behaviour. We present a source-level, multi-case study of three open coding-agent harnesses built from deliberately opposing philosophies: LangChain's deepagents (batteries-included), Earendil's pi (radical minimalism), and DeepSeek's dsh (everything-is-a-plugin). translated_title: 帝国，久分必合：三个LLM智能体框架的架构趋同
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.23953v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：智能体框架是将语言模型转变为自主智能体的关键：它包含构建模型上下文、调解其工具、运行循环以及在长周期运行中持久化状态的周围代码。这一层，而非其所包装的模型，正日益成为智能体行为的约束瓶颈。我们呈现了一个源码级、多案例研究，聚焦于三个基于刻意对立哲学构建的开源编码智能体框架：LangChain的deepagents（内置丰富功能）、Earendil的pi（极端简约主义）和DeepSeek的dsh（一切皆插件）。通过固定提交版本阅读每个框架并跟踪其提交历史，我们发现这两个成熟的框架已朝着相反方向演进（deepagents减少作者化脚手架，pi增加持久基础设施），却最终趋同于一种包含五个重复元素的架构中间形态：商品化循环、仅追加可重放会话记录、模型怪癖保留为数据
tldr: 本文通过分析三个开源编码智能体框架的源码和演进历史，发现它们虽从对立哲学出发，却最终在架构上趋同于一个包含商品化循环、可重放会话记录等五要素的中间形态，表明智能体框架的约束正从模型转向其外层代码架构。
en_tdlr: This paper analyzes three open-source coding agent harnesses and finds that despite starting from opposing philosophies, they converge on an intermediate architectural form with five recurring elements, revealing that the binding constraint on agent behavior is shifting from the model to the surrounding harness code.
